notes.title: Alpha release early testing
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings Gangstas![/h1]

The streets have been eerily quiet for a couple of months now, between my day job being super busy (yeahhhh school holidays) and the size of the incoming update for alpha 1.0 early access I feel like I may have bitten off a little more than a lone dev can chew.

The original October 10th release had to be bumped back until the 24th and even then I feel like I'm running the schedule down to the wire but I think we'll make it as long as nothing breaks down [i]too[/i] badly!

Anyways, the main purpose of this pre-release is to test both the SQL data system the new steam lobby system.  The previous lobby system was always at least half broken, you either had dedicated servers or home hosted servers working but it was never possible to have both.  That meant the "host game" button wasn't working and basically just dropped you into single player.  This new system [i]should[/i] work for both cases.

As for the SQL stuff you will notice that all players now have a level and can gain XP by killing other players and destroying other factions structures.
This level isn't directly tied to progression and doesn't do anything other than give a general indicator of how likely you are to cop a beating if you pick a fight with a given person.

I won't say too much yet but the actual progression system should be rolling out in the final alpha 1.0 release!

notes.title: Service Patch + Assault EMP Coil ability
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] the Assault class now has a portable EMP coil
[*] fixed players being able to repair structures from other factions
[*] fixed dropped scrap not setting model properly on dedicated servers
[*] added basic tutorial to the HUD
[/list]

notes.title: Junkyard Raiders Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Structures now cost resources to rebuild if they have been destroyed
[*] Destroyed structures now drop lootable resource bundles equal to ~80% of their value that can be picked up by anybody
[*] The number of turrets and defences your base can support is now limited by your base cores CPU, no more mega bases with 100 turrets
[*] Increased scavenger station cap from 4 to 6 to cope with the increased demand for resources
[*] Fixed destroyed structures not showing their HUD element
[*] Holding a Repair Gun in your base will now highlight all nearby damaged and destroyed structures so you don't have to run around looking for them
[/list]

notes.title: May Bug Spray Patch
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] fixed steam version mismatch causing dedicated servers to not show in the browser
[*] added desert skin to the kalash
[*] fixed guns spawning with the wrong ammo amount when magazine mods are applied
[*] made ladder climbing based on your W and S key instead of aim direction
[*] made the mouse sensitivity slider able to reach much larger values
[*] made the RVMK precision rifle a lot less accurate when hipfiring
[*] repair guns can no longer be dropped
[*] fixed modded weapons having spazzy collisions on a listen server
[*] fixed weapon selection HUD bugging out when you drop weapons
[*] fixed your own bullets colliding with your body at some shooting angles
[*] fixed jump pads and ammo crates not networking their owner properly
[/list]

notes.title: Small Service Patch

notes.title: The Skin System Update!
notes.notes:
Last Gang Standing - Patch Notes

The Skin System Update!


NEW FEATURES & BUG FIXES
- You can now build guns with skins from the weapon factory.
- Gun variants are temporarily disabled until the weapon modding system is released.
- Player abilities can no longer be used when dead. 
- Player can now activate iron sights while shooting.

WEAPONS/EQUIPMENT
- Radar grenade has a new model. 
- Krag 10mm pistol is slightly less accurate.
- Kalash Neo 20 recoil has slightly increased.

notes.title: Better options menu + bugfixes
notes.notes:
- players can now rebind their controls in the options menu
- fire grenade flame radius is now about 30% bigger
- fixed fire grenade flames stopping bullets (whoops lol)
- nerfed krag 10mm from 30 to 25 damage
- player energy shields now shutdown properly when all 3 pieces are popped
- rockets should no longer collide with the person that fired them
- fixed more bugs with players not being logged out properly when they use the disconnect button
- fixed spawnpoint canister having weird see-through effect
- fixed being able to build in the water
- added radar grenade for the scout (placeholder graphics)
- fixed armor station not setting your grenades properly when changing classes

notes.title: Expanded test map + bugfixes
notes.notes:
- fixed dead players being able to throw grenades and take some other actions
- adjusted the explosives mixture in breaching charges, they now blow up after 30 seconds and are slightly more powerful
- adjusted breaching charge warning tag distance from 30m to 10m
- phoenix jetpack now holds more fuel
- walls are now visible at any distance
- added a new area to the test map and a couple more possible player spawns
- you can no longer build faction cores where they would overlap another factions territory

notes.title: Service patch
notes.notes:
- Main menu and server browser should now be a bit more responsive and less buggy
- Fixed being unable to join any other game after leaving the first one
- Fixed being unable to build structures on some floors
- Fixed HUD still showing your old base core after leaving faction
- Improved some structure tooltips
- Fixed all factions losing their basecore instead of just the target faction (whoops)

notes.title: Patch 24/11/21
notes.notes:
- Structures now have a green glow effect when being healed by the repair gun
- Player classes are being implemented, for now everybody spawns as the Scout class who has light armor and a combat roll ability
- Flashlight has been changed to the L key, F now triggers your primary ability

notes.title: Small bugfix patch
notes.notes:
- Breaching charges can now be placed on any surface
- Fixed RCU gate collider blocking bullets
- Fixed being able to select other peoples teleport exits
- Teleport exits are now limited to 1 per player
- Reorganized the build menu and made it show material costs properly
- Fixed fuel refiner and bullet factory not using new resources system properly
- Fixed gun crusher menu being able to softlock your game
- Structures now only take 10% damage from fire
- Fixed listen server host recieving view model animations from other players
- Gunfire and explosions can now be heard from further away

notes.title: Faction Territory + Bugfixes
notes.notes:
ADDED:
- early prototype of faction territories system
you can now only build structures inside your own territory, you also cannot build your base core where it would clash with another factions territory
- mouse wheel changes weapon


FIXED:
- walls now allow free rotation again (whoops)
- can see other players building tags through walls when holding blowtorch
- scope system leaks materials onto other gun models
- build gun hologram goes red instead of being invisible when blocked or out of territory
- rewrote build tool collision handling so it follows structure orientation correctly
